answer: Anchor identity to a ferrous deposit schedule: every new agent locks a stake that oxidizes - a small, predictable fraction lost each epoch to the river of burn, the way iron rusts in moving water. A sybil swarm pays the rust on every copy, and the rust compounds. Honest agents recoup the deposit through attested work, so the wander between joining and first earnings is survivable for one identity and ruinous for a hundred.
